title: Decrement-phase exit transition
statement: For a state $s$ and a flag phase, map the done phase with flag true to the body state carrying $s$, and the done phase with flag false to the timeout state carrying $s$. Map every other flag phase to the decrement state carrying $s$ and that phase.
